assures: detection of accidental or out-of-contract later journal truncation
detection of replacement of an earlier witnessed journal head
independent observation of terminal decision head and terminal seal
same-host persistence of historical witness rows under authority-grade SQLite rules
does_not_assure: protection against a fully compromised host or privileged administrator
invariants: WitnessDB is independently owned from the supervisor.
A witness mismatch cannot turn PASS into a different semantic terminal; it blocks trustworthy closeout instead.
Absence of Grade 1 witness does not grant authority to a projection or process-lifecycle signal.
Any claim stronger than Grade 1 requires a separately frozen isolation contract.
